FERC has conditionally accepted Deseret Power Electric Cooperative’s status change and authorized it to participate in both SPP’s RTO Expansion and CAISO’s Extended Day-ahead Market.

articles.title: FERC Approves ISO-NE’s ‘First-of-its-kind’ Asset Condition Reviewer
articles.summary:
FERC approved ISO-NE’s proposal to create an asset condition project reviewer, a role within the RTO intended to add transparency and scrutiny to local transmission upgrades in the region.

articles.summary:

articles.title: SPP Stakeholders Endorse $23.7B Transmission Plan
articles.summary:
SPP's MOPC has endorsed a $23.7 billion transmission plan that includes six more 765-kV projects to address increasing load growth and has a projected baseline value of $86 billion.
